notes: Connected-speech vowelling (i'rab) on words followed by a hamzat-wasl article so the article is elided correctly (al-iṣḥāḥu s-sādisa, not al-iṣḥāḥ ʔas-sādis).
Compound ordinals 11-19 are built on fatha for both parts: السَّادِسَ عَشَرَ (m.), الرَّابِعَةَ عَشْرَةَ / السَّادِسَةَ عَشْرَةَ (f.). The current drafts omit the joining fatha.
Phrase-final words stay pausal (sukun / taa marbuta read as -a).

piperPhonemes are hand-written espeak-ng IPA for the Kareem voice: espeak-ng ar reads hamzat-wasl articles as ʔa-, reads آيَة as ʔaːiːat, and keeps -at on pausal taa marbuta. Closed vocabulary (book names, ordinals, fixed words) makes a reviewed lexicon practical for all 537 references.
